items.description: Clean pushed GitHub Actions run for the exact release branch.
required_evidence: tools/ciprobe JSON report with SRC-CI-001 evidence item from the uploaded artifact file or URL
Uploaded GitHub Actions ci-release-evidence artifact from the release SHA

items.description: Terraform remote state is initialized and the staging plan/apply completes against real inputs.
required_evidence: tools/deploymentprobe -probe-terraform JSON report with DEPLOY-TF-001 evidence item
terraform init output with remote backend
terraform plan artifact proving EKS, node group, RDS, Redis, workload deployments, ingresses, SecretProviderClass, and IAM role resources
terraform apply output or DEPLOY-TF-001 deployment approval record

items.description: DNS, ACM, ALB ingress, HTTPS redirect, and TLS policy are proven against deployed API and web hostnames.
required_evidence: HTTP to HTTPS redirect probe output

items.description: Kubernetes API, web, and Rust engine workloads are running with readiness/liveness probes, PDBs, HPAs, and rolling update settings.
required_evidence: tools/deploymentprobe -probe-kubernetes JSON report with DEPLOY-K8S-001 evidence item
kubectl rollout status output proving API, web, and Rust workloads are rolled out, ready, and available
kubectl get deploy,svc,ingress,hpa,pdb output proving services, ingresses, HPA targets, and PDB min availability

items.description: Secrets Store CSI and IRSA sync runtime secrets from the cloud secret manager without committed plaintext.
required_evidence: tools/securityprobe -probe-secrets JSON report with SEC-SECRETS-001 evidence item
IRSA role annotation and trust policy
Scoped Secrets Manager access test proving configured-secret allow and unscoped-secret AccessDenied

items.description: DATABASE_URL uses a scoped application database user rather than the RDS root user.
required_evidence: tools/securityprobe -probe-db-user JSON report with SEC-DBUSER-001 evidence item

items.description: Auth, AI, journal, room, and WebSocket abuse limits are observed through real staging ingress behavior.
required_evidence: tools/abuseprobe JSON report with ABUSE-LIMIT-001 evidence item
429 responses for auth, AI, journal, rooms, and WebSocket profiles
Staging ABUSE_LIMIT_* configuration used for the probe

items.description: Tenant RLS behavior is proven through the deployed API and staging database connection pool.
required_evidence: tools/tenantprobe JSON report with DATA-RLS-001 evidence item

items.description: Redis-backed room sequencing is contiguous under deployed multi-client concurrency.
required_evidence: No duplicate or skipped sequence proof

items.description: Deployed Rust gRPC service is reachable from the Go API and exposes health and metrics.
required_evidence: tools/rustprobe JSON report with RUST-GRPC-001 evidence item

items.description: OpenTelemetry collector/backend receives traces and preserves trace IDs across API and Rust logs.
required_evidence: tools/observabilityprobe -probe-otel JSON report with OBS-OTEL-001 evidence item

items.description: Dashboard import, alert delivery, and telemetry retention are proven in staging.
required_evidence: tools/observabilityprobe -probe-alerts JSON report with OBS-ALERT-001 evidence item
Grafana dashboard import screenshot or export

items.description: Deployed web app completes browser smoke flows against staging API and WebSocket endpoints.
Mobile native-device or EAS validation proves the AES-GCM binding and staging endpoint config outside Node/WebCrypto shims.
required_evidence: tools/mobileprobe JSON report with CLIENT-MOBILE-001 evidence item

items.description: Zoom OAuth, meeting creation fallback, webhook signature validation, duplicate webhook idempotency, and room mapping are proven with staging credentials.
required_evidence: tools/zoomprobe JSON report with EXT-ZOOM-001 evidence item

items.description: AI provider configuration, timeout/degradation behavior, citation verification, and audit persistence are proven in staging.
required_evidence: tools/aiprobe JSON report with EXT-AI-001 evidence item
ai_request_logs and citation_trails query output with request_id, organization_id, and user_id proof

items.description: Staging HTTP load test proves or revises the architecture target of 5000 requests per second with P99 under 200ms.
required_evidence: tools/loadtest JSON report with PERF-HTTP-001 evidence item
Database and Redis telemetry during the run

items.description: Staging WebSocket load test proves multi-instance fan-out and Redis sequencing with real API replicas.
required_evidence: tools/loadtest -websocket JSON report with PERF-WS-001 and DATA-REDIS-001 evidence items

items.description: Rollback and degradation paths are exercised in staging.
required_evidence: tools/resilienceprobe -probe-rollback JSON report with DR-ROLLBACK-001 evidence item
kubectl rollout undo or equivalent rollback output
API readiness before and after rollback

items.description: RDS backup creation and restore drill are proven in staging.
required_evidence: tools/resilienceprobe -probe-backup JSON report with DR-BACKUP-001 evidence item

items.description: Threat model, dependency risk register, and residual production risks receive owner/security signoff.
